module: Event log of a rally loop. Each entry (item) carries a timestamp, an eventId, an eventGroup, a type ('penalty', etc.) and a data table. On each addition, the aggregates are recomputed: total penalty, total stage time, total time (stages + penalties) and penalty summary by group and by type. Used by rallyLoopManager and rallyAttempts.
usage:
local log = require('gameplay_rally_loop_rallyEventLog')()
log:addItem({eventId='ss1', eventGroup='SS1'}, 12.3, 'penalty', {penaltyType='speeding', amount=10})
print(log:getTotalPenalty())
notes: The module returns a constructor function; the options passed are forwarded to C:init (which uses none).
Only items whose data.stageTimeSecs exists count as stage time; only items of type 'penalty' with data.amount count in the penalty.
An item without data would cause an error in getStageTimes/_calcTotalStageTime (access to item.data.stageTimeSecs without a guard).
C:clear() empties items and itemsByEventGroup but does not reset aggregatedItems: the totals stay as before until the next addItem.

C.desc: Event log. Instance fields: items (ordered list), itemsByEventGroup (table eventGroup -> list), aggregatedItems (totalPenalty, totalStageTime, totalTime, penaltySummary).

init.desc: Initializes the empty lists. Called by the constructor.

addItem.desc: Adds an entry to the log and to the event's group, then recomputes the aggregates. eventId and eventGroup are 'unknown' if absent.

event.desc: Source event with eventId and eventGroup.

recalculateAggregatedItems.desc: Recomputes totalPenalty, totalStageTime, totalTime and penaltySummary. Called by addItem.

getItemsByEventGroup.desc: Returns the items of an event group (empty table if none).

getAllItems.desc: Returns all the items in the order they were added.

getItemsByType.desc: Returns the items whose type matches.

getStageTimes.desc: Returns the items that carry data.stageTimeSecs (one per completed stage).

getTotalPenalty.desc: Total penalty in seconds (0 if none).

getTotalStageTime.desc: Sum of the stage times in seconds.

getTotalTime.desc: Stage times plus penalties, in seconds.

getPenaltySummary.desc: Penalty summary: {totalPenalty, groups = {{eventGroup, totalPenalty, penalties = {{type, count, amount}}}}}. Groups follow the order of first appearance, penalties are sorted by type.

_calcTotalPenalty.desc: Sum of data.amount of the items of type 'penalty'.

_calcTotalStageTime.desc: Sum of data.stageTimeSecs of all items.

_calcPenaltySummary.desc: Builds the penalty summary by group then by penaltyType.

clear.desc: Empties the log (items and groups) and logs a debug message. The aggregates are not recomputed.
